stages.name: Style + engine 2D/3D (dipilih AI, tanpa acc) → cover topik

notes.text: HISTORYMAP, Remotion + R3F 3D: meja peta pengepungan Bagdad dua tepi Tigris, basis kode EP19 khalid. Alternatif: HD2D, MOSAICFORGE.
STYLE_DECISION.md penuh, cover-reference.png disalin dari EP19. Cover topik dirender di Sesi B setelah scaffold (preseden EP19).

stages.name: Naskah 6 tahap + storyboard + art direction + estimasi durasi

notes.text: Naskah final 193 kata, 8 segmen s1–s8, ≈77–83 dtk. Klaim Hulagu 2 juta, 40 hari, dan 'diinjak kuda' dibuang. ART_DIRECTION, STORYBOARD, ASSET_MANIFEST ditulis (Style: HISTORYMAP).

stages.name: Shotlist + animasi 3D + still per beat + sound design (npm run sfx)
Draf: contact sheet frame kunci (+ klip 15–20 dtk bila perlu) + audit visual
Gerbang render final (acc) → Final 1080×1920 @ 60 + QA audio/visual + outro AUDIRA
Caption 6 platform + jadwal upload + label AI (validator ok) + NOTES.md + tampil di chat + jadwalkan review (3 scheduled task)
Review pasca-tayang 24 jam / 72 jam / 7 hari (views, retensi, hook) → NOTES.md
